name: AP-10K 17-point animal pose schema

visibility.1: labeled but occluded; location inferred from body plan, pose, or symmetry

keypoints.name: Left eye
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Left eye landmark as named by AP-10K.

keypoints.name: Right eye
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Right eye landmark as named by AP-10K.

keypoints.name: Nose
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Nose landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Head-position reference only; not validated on walking dogs.

keypoints.name: Neck
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Neck landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential body reference; requires side-view validation.

keypoints.name: Root of tail
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Tail-root landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential rear-body reference; requires side-view validation.

keypoints.name: Left shoulder
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Left shoulder landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential forelimb reference; requires side-view validation.

keypoints.name: Left elbow
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Left elbow landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential forelimb reference; requires side-view validation.

keypoints.name: Left front paw
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Left front-paw landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential paw trajectory; gait interpretation remains unvalidated.

keypoints.name: Right shoulder
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Right shoulder landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential forelimb reference; requires side-view validation.

keypoints.name: Right elbow
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Right elbow landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential forelimb reference; requires side-view validation.

keypoints.name: Right front paw
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Right front-paw landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential paw trajectory; gait interpretation remains unvalidated.

keypoints.name: Left hip
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: AP-10K's left hip label. Its documentation uses this label for the knee in digitigrade animals such as dogs.
keypoints.gait_use: Do not interpret as the anatomical hip for dogs without a validated remapping.

keypoints.name: Left knee
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: AP-10K's left knee label. Its documentation uses this label for the ankle in digitigrade animals such as dogs.
keypoints.gait_use: Do not interpret as the anatomical knee for dogs without a validated remapping.

keypoints.name: Left back paw
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Left back-paw landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential paw trajectory; gait interpretation remains unvalidated.

keypoints.name: Right hip
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: AP-10K's right hip label. Its documentation uses this label for the knee in digitigrade animals such as dogs.
keypoints.gait_use: Do not interpret as the anatomical hip for dogs without a validated remapping.

keypoints.name: Right knee
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: AP-10K's right knee label. Its documentation uses this label for the ankle in digitigrade animals such as dogs.
keypoints.gait_use: Do not interpret as the anatomical knee for dogs without a validated remapping.

keypoints.name: Right back paw
keypoints.anatomical_meaning: Right back-paw landmark as named by AP-10K.
keypoints.gait_use: Potential paw trajectory; gait interpretation remains unvalidated.

use_limitations: The AP-10K keypoint schema is shared across animal species and is not a dog-only annotation protocol.
AP-10K's documentation states that for digitigrade animals the labels hip and knee denote the knee and ankle, respectively.
Image-level pose metrics do not validate video tracking, walking gait, or clinical interpretation.
